fact: The 2025 ASIN vulnerabilities and incidents report, drawn from bjCSIRT data for 2021-2024, publishes counts (878 vulnerabilities, 832 password leaks, 23 malware infections, 12 website hackings, 7 botnet activations).
title: Rapport de vulnérabilités et d'incidents 2025
publisher: Agence des Systèmes d'Information et du Numérique (ASIN)
